title: chat-filenode: chatspace root destroy conflicts with filenode-19
description: draft-atwood-jmap-chat-filenode-00 grants manage_space mayDelete/mayRename on the chatspace root and says manage_space can destroy it. filenode-19 Access Control: a Directory with a role cannot be destroyed, renamed or moved (forbidden). The root can only go away with the Space (#deletion).
close_reason: Fixed permission table and root rules in draft-atwood-jmap-chat-filenode-00 #permissions to match filenode-19 rights model
